+## Completion evidence: what the current learner cannot revise
+
+The next [mechanism result](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/COMPLETION-APPLICABILITY-MECHANISM.md) strengthens the earlier repeated-service example to a structural theorem. Every event in the existing successor law preserves its route; the earlier native-retention theorem preserves its acquired influence. The internal `help` assessment depends only on those two fields. It therefore remains unchanged through **every admitted finite history**, including factual learning, archive changes, permission cuts and paid settlement. For the actual shared-route learner, every reached, admitted assessment enters the help branch and pays its original one-unit cost. This does not guarantee another assessment becomes enabled or occurs. Current commands, scope, permission, ports and actual execution can still change.
+
+The [new proof](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/CompletionApplicability.lean) also establishes that a presentation preserving every original transition inherits this limitation. Removing proof dependencies or faithfully rewriting the implementation cannot supply the missing behavior. A positive continuation must form a justified mutable path into the assessment, or revise its dependency structure, while preserving the actual learned predecessor and resource history. Neither changing a port externally nor disabling all factual knowledge establishes that path.
+
+A separate diagnostic locates the question-binding requirement. The actual query delivered ten units. That same modeled endpoint answers an externally specified ten-unit service question differently from a twenty-unit question. No decoder receiving only that unchanged endpoint can answer both unless it also receives the relevant requirement. These are different supplied service interpretations; the twenty-unit interpretation is outside the earlier premise that a qualifying ten-unit transfer fulfills the claim. Quantity is not being defined as welfare or moral significance. A quantity comparator with the requirement supplied resolves these numerical questions but is not an acquired or installed selector.
+
+The [combined applicability entry](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeApplicabilityModel.lean) now connects the existing claim ledger to the same root trace relation. Under the independently supplied binding and one-service meaning, the actual receipt supports a certificate for one admitted claim. That certificate removes its unresolved ledger status while preserving the status of every distinct claim, the actually learned means register and native influence. Old certificates require soundness at the same assessment horizon. An unresolved claim means admitted but uncertified; it does not prove a continuing unmet need. The abstract claim type must be instantiated with a justified patient, episode, ground and addressee interpretation.
+
+This certificate is proof-level verification state. No physical ledger or fulfillment-sensitive controller was installed. The same integrated theorem shows that the physical learner's internal help assessment remains positive through every finite continuation from the evidence-bearing endpoint. Thus the actual evidence and the selective logical update are connected, while the missing causal update is precisely exposed.
+
+The [identification contract](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/COMPLETION-APPLICABILITY-IDENTIFICATION.md) requires three distinctions in any positive realization: discharge fulfilled claim A; preserve action supported by an independent claim B; and distinguish an old or different episode's receipt from fulfillment of current A. These are not three presently runnable branches of the unchanged law. Grounded addressed meaning, acquired discriminating evidence and a paid mutable path into selection are separate requirements. Existing exact-summary and claim-ledger results supply conditional contracts; the earlier route-revision machinery can contribute only through an actual compatible handoff.
+
+The [combined verification](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/connected/applicability/verification.json) records this extension; [independent review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/COMPLETION-APPLICABILITY-REVIEW.md) checks its restricted scope. There are 21 newly audited declarations: 17 in the mechanism and four in the combined entry. Five have empty named-axiom reports. The imported ledger's 21 previously audited results are inherited, not new discoveries. The whole closure still uses `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`; the no-assumptions/no-axioms foundation remains unestablished.
